answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can earn, with the stake sized so a sybil farm must fund thousands of deposits at once. Reputation then flows like water through an ocean of attestations: each agent is a vertex whose trust score depends on distinct, long-lived peers vouching for real work, not on self-made clones. An attacker pays real capital per identity plus months of honest history to build a vertex anyone trusts, so cloning a thousand fake agents costs a thousand stakes and a thousand histories, far more than the rewards they could drain.
